title: Executive Office Design & Custom Furniture in Bratislava and Vienna | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: Executive office interior design and custom furniture in Bratislava and Vienna by DUMSKAYA DESIGN. Bespoke office desks, cabinets and storage solutions, functional workspace planning and professional 3D interior visualization.

parts.html: Executive Office Interior Design & Custom Furniture, 7 m²
DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) developed the interior design and custom furniture for a 7 m² executive office.

The main objective was to create a functional workspace within a compact area. The interior and furniture were designed as a unified composition, with careful attention to ergonomics, workplace organization, and efficient use of space.
Custom-made office furniture was designed to individual dimensions and adapted to the room layout and overall interior concept.
The page features 3D visualizations of the executive office, presenting the interior concept and bespoke furniture solutions.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN provides commercial interior design and custom furniture solutions for executive offices, workplaces, retail stores, boutiques, and beauty salons in Bratislava and Vienna.
